items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: Tito start playing... Chano stop and said... Vidal, you do ka-ka... and I know what I'm going to do.

ctx.x: But when we got to the studio, Carlos Mangual Vidal, everybody, Tito start playing, and Chano stop and said, is that 7" what (inaudible). And Chano said, no, no, no, no, wait a minute. (Inaudible), you do too-too-too-too-too-too, too-too, and do that from the beginning and (inaudible). Vidal, you do ka-ka, um-ka-ka, um-ka-ka, um-ka-ka, um-ka-ka. Gran, you pa-pa-pa-pa-pa. Miguelito know what he going to do (Inaudible), and I know what I'm going to do. Let's go one, two, three, four. Machito look at Mangual…
